legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.terms.intro: These terms are the agreement between you and Wisecall. Please read them before you use the site. If you do not agree, please do not use it.

p: Wisecall is a marketplace. People who want advice (“seekers”) pay to ask a question, and people with experience (“mentors”) answer it.
Mentors are independent people, not employees or agents of Wisecall. Wisecall is not a party to the advice itself. We provide the platform, take payment, and pay mentors.
You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. Give us accurate information and keep your password private. You are responsible for everything that happens under your account.
You must confirm your email address before you can apply to become a mentor. One person may have one account.

Answers on Wisecall are personal opinions and experience shared by individuals. They are not professional medical, legal, financial, tax, or psychological advice, and they do not create a doctor–patient, lawyer–client, or any other professional relationship, even when the mentor holds a licence in that field.

Do not use Wisecall for emergencies. If you or someone else may be in danger, contact your local emergency number. Always consult a qualified professional who can look at your full situation before you make important medical, legal, or financial decisions.

The price of a question is set by the mentor in Georgian lari (GEL) and shown before you pay. You pay when you send the question, by card on the secure payment page of our payment bank. Wisecall never sees or stores your full card details.
Your payment is held until the mentor answers. The mentor is paid only after they have answered.

Wisecall is not a bank. The payment is taken by a licensed Georgian bank that processes it for us. The amount you see is the amount you pay in lari, and any currency conversion by your own card issuer is outside our control.
If a mentor does not answer within 7 days of your payment, we refund you in full automatically. You do not need to ask.

After a question has been answered, payments are generally not refundable, because the answer has been delivered. We will refund in full when the answer is clearly spam, is empty or off-topic, or breaks these terms. To ask for this, contact us within 7 days of receiving the answer.
Disliking or disagreeing with an answer is not a reason for a refund. You can leave an honest review instead.
Refunds go back to the original payment method. Your bank may need several business days to show them. Please contact us before starting a chargeback, so we can fix the problem first.

If you apply to be a mentor, you promise that everything you tell us about yourself is true, including your job title, experience, qualifications, and the proof link you provide. Pretending to be someone you are not, or claiming credentials you do not have, leads to removal and may lead to legal action.

Mentors must: answer honestly and in good faith; answer within the deadline; stay within their real area of expertise; not present an answer as a diagnosis, legal opinion, or financial recommendation for a specific person; keep what seekers tell them confidential; and follow the laws that apply to them, including any licensing rules in their profession.
Mentors must not ask seekers to pay outside Wisecall, must not share a seeker’s question publicly without permission, and must not send spam or promote unrelated services.

Mentors are responsible for their own taxes on the money they earn. To be paid, a mentor must give Wisecall their full name and a valid Georgian IBAN in Settings. Until then their profile stays hidden and they cannot receive questions.
We may approve or reject mentor applications and remove a mentor at any time, for example if they get poor reviews, break these terms, or we cannot verify them.

How mentor payouts work: for each answered question, the mentor earns the price minus the Wisecall platform fee. This becomes payable 7 days after the answer, which is the period in which a buyer can ask for a refund. Wisecall then pays it by bank transfer to the IBAN the mentor gave, in periodic manual transfers. If a buyer is refunded after the mentor has already been paid, the refunded amount is deducted from the mentor’s next payout.

Wisecall keeps a platform fee from each paid question (currently 20% of the price). The rest goes to the mentor. Our payment provider also charges its own processing fees, which are covered by the platform fee. The fee for a specific payment is stored with that payment and does not change afterwards.

Do not use Wisecall to break the law, harass or threaten anyone, share hateful or sexual content, impersonate others, send spam, try to get around the platform’s security or payments, or collect other users’ data.
Do not include other people’s private information in a question. Do not submit a question that asks the mentor to help you do something illegal or harmful.

You own what you write. By posting it on Wisecall you give us permission to store it, show it to the people it is meant for, and, for a mentor’s public profile and reviews, display it on the site. We may remove content that breaks these terms.
Reviews are shown with the reviewer’s first name and the initial of their last name.

After a paid question has been answered, the person who asked and the mentor can each rate the other once: 1 to 5 stars and a few tags. The person who asked can also write a review of the mentor. The mentor can add a private note for the Wisecall team, which the asker never sees.

Ratings stay hidden until both people have rated, or until 7 days after the answer became readable for the buyer, whichever comes first. Until then you can change your rating; after that you cannot. You can rate for up to 30 days after the answer.

A mentor’s average, number of ratings, tags and written reviews are public on their profile, with the reviewer’s name and photo (or “Anonymous asker” if the reviewer’s profile is private). A mentor may reply to a review once, in public. An asker’s average is never shown under 3 ratings; after that only a badge and the most common tags are shown. Mentors can see an asker’s rating on the question.

Rate honestly and only from your own experience of that question. A rating or review must not contain insults, threats, hate, personal data (yours or anybody else’s), advertising, or claims you know to be untrue. Mentors may not ask for, pay for or trade ratings, and may not pressure people to change them.

Anyone who is logged in can report a review. Wisecall may hide a review that breaks these rules, and records who decided and why. We do not remove a review only because it is critical. Hidden reviews do not count towards averages.
A very low average, for a mentor or for an asker, is checked by our team. It can lead to a warning, a limit or, for a mentor, suspension under the section on suspending and closing accounts.

We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms or puts others at risk. You can stop using Wisecall at any time. If we close your account without a breach on your part, we will refund any question you paid for that was not answered.

We try to keep Wisecall available and accurate, but we provide it “as is”. We cannot promise that every answer is correct, useful, or suitable for you, and we are not responsible for decisions you make based on an answer.

To the extent the law allows, Wisecall’s total responsibility to you for any claim about the service is limited to the amount you paid for the question involved. Nothing in these terms removes rights that the law says cannot be removed.
We may update these terms. If a change matters, we will tell you by email or on the site before it applies. If you keep using Wisecall after that, you accept the new terms.
These terms are governed by the laws of Georgia. Disputes go to the competent courts of Georgia, unless the law gives you the right to go elsewhere as a consumer.
Questions about these terms, or a refund request? Use the contact page on this site.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: This explains what personal data Wisecall collects, why, and what your rights are. We keep it to what we need to run the service.

p: Wisecall is responsible (the “controller”) for the personal data described here. You can reach us through the contact page on this site.
Account data: your name, email address, and a password (stored only as a one-way hash, never in readable form), plus your language choice.

Profile data: your username, photo, headline, current work or study, city, languages, short bio, and optional LinkedIn and website links. You choose who can see them: everyone, or only people you have had a question with (the profile of a mentor who is listed on Wisecall is always public). Photos are resized and stripped of hidden data such as the place they were taken. Your email address, bank details and verification documents are never shown on a profile.

Sign in with Google: if you choose “Continue with Google”, Google tells us your name, your email address, whether Google has verified that address, your picture, and an identifier of your Google account. We do not receive your Google password, and we get no access to your Google data beyond these basics. You can disconnect Google in Settings once you have set a password.

Mentor data: if you apply to be a mentor, your job title, field, bio, price, the proof link you give us (for example a LinkedIn profile), and your sample answer. Your title, field, bio, and price become public once you are approved. Your proof link, sample answer, and email are never public.
Questions and answers: the questions you send, the answers you receive, and reviews you write.

Payment data: your card details are entered on our payment bank’s secure page and processed by the bank. We receive only the payment status, amount and the bank’s reference numbers. We never see or store your full card number. Mentors give us their full name and IBAN so we can pay them; the IBAN is stored encrypted and is visible only to the mentor and to Wisecall administrators who make the payouts.
Technical data: your IP address and basic request information appear in server logs and are used to prevent abuse (for example, limiting repeated login attempts).

Ratings and reviews: the stars, tags and written reviews you give or receive, and (for mentors) any private note to our team. A mentor’s ratings and written reviews are public. An asker’s rating is shown only as a badge, after 3 ratings. Private notes are read only by the Wisecall team.
Every mentor is checked before they appear on Wisecall. This section explains what that involves and applies only to people who apply to be mentors.

ID and selfie check: we use an identity verification provider, Didit (didit.me), to check a government ID document and a live selfie. You send your ID photos and selfie directly to the provider. Wisecall does not receive or store them. We receive and keep only the provider’s verification ID, the result (approved, declined or in review), your verified full name, date of birth and country, and the time of the check. Your verified name and date of birth are stored encrypted. The provider handles your data under its own privacy policy and its agreement with us.

Names: we compare the name on your ID with your profile name, the name on your license or registry entry, and the name of your payout account holder. If they do not match, a member of our team looks at it before anything is approved.

Professional proof: depending on your field we ask for your license or registration number, who issued it and when it expires; a supporting document (a PDF or JPG such as a scan of your license, diploma or proof of your role); a company identification number; a work email address (we send a confirmation code to it); and a link to your portfolio. Your license number and uploaded documents are stored encrypted and are visible only to the Wisecall administrators who review applications. Uploaded documents are deleted 90 days after we make a decision.
Video interview: in regulated fields (such as medicine, law and finance) we hold a short video call with you. We keep the time of the call, the result and our reviewers’ notes.

Records: every decision is written to an audit log with who made it, when and why. Your public profile shows only badges for the checks you passed (for example “ID verified”) and the date of the check. It never shows your ID, date of birth, license number or documents.

Ongoing checks: after approval we keep watching quality. Your first answers may be reviewed before they reach the buyer, reports from buyers and low ratings are reviewed by our team, and license expiry dates are tracked. We may suspend a profile if a check fails or a serious problem is reported.

How long we keep it: uploaded documents are deleted 90 days after a decision. The result of your ID check, your verified name, date of birth and country, and your license details are kept while your mentor account exists, and afterwards for as long as the law requires.
We use one essential cookie to keep you logged in. It is not used for advertising or tracking. We also store your language choice in your browser. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.
To create and secure your account, and to send the emails you need: verification codes, password resets, and notifications about your questions and answers.
To run the marketplace: show mentor profiles, deliver questions and answers, take payments, pay mentors, and issue refunds.
To review mentor applications and keep the platform safe from fraud and misuse.
To meet legal duties, such as keeping payment records.
We do not sell your personal data.
The mentor you ask receives your name and your question. A seeker receives the mentor’s answer.

Service providers that work for us: our payment bank (card payments and refunds), our identity verification provider (mentors only), our email provider (sending emails), and our hosting and database provider. They may only use the data to provide their service to us.
Google: if you use Google sign-in, Google learns that you signed in to Wisecall, under Google’s own privacy policy. Nothing about your questions or answers is sent to Google.
Authorities, when the law requires it.
The public can see public profiles, and a mentor’s ratings and reviews (with the reviewer’s name and photo, or “Anonymous asker” when the reviewer’s profile is private).
Our providers may process data outside Georgia, for example in the European Union or the United States. When that happens, we rely on providers that protect data to a suitable standard.

We keep your account data while your account exists. If you ask us to delete your account, we delete or anonymise your personal data, except records we must keep by law, such as payment records, and data needed to handle a dispute.
Login verification codes and password reset tokens expire within minutes or hours and are stored only as hashes.

You can ask us to give you a copy of your data, correct it, delete it, limit how we use it, or stop using it for something you object to. You can also withdraw a consent you gave. Contact us and we will answer within a reasonable time.
If you believe we handled your data unlawfully, you can complain to the Personal Data Protection Service of Georgia.
Passwords are hashed, connections use HTTPS, and access to data is limited. No system is perfectly secure, so please use a strong, unique password.
Wisecall is for people 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you think a child has given us data, contact us and we will delete it.
We may update this policy. When we make a meaningful change, we will tell you by email or on the site.

legal.about.title: About Wisecall
legal.about.intro: Wisecall lets people who are just starting out ask a real question and get a real answer from someone who has already done what they want to do.

p: Most of us learned the important things about a career from one honest conversation with the right person. Not everyone has that person in their life. A student who wants to become a doctor, a first-time founder, or a new teacher often has nobody to ask.
Wisecall puts experienced people within reach and makes it worth their time. You pay a fair price, they answer properly, and both sides know what to expect.
1. Find a mentor in your field and read their profile and reviews.
2. Ask your question and pay. The money is held safely until you get your answer.
3. The mentor answers. You get it by email and in your dashboard, and you can leave a review.
If a mentor does not answer within 7 days, you are refunded automatically.

Nobody appears on Wisecall just by signing up. Every mentor confirms their email, passes a government ID and live selfie check with our identity partner (the name has to match their profile and payout account), links to proof of what they have done, and writes a sample answer. They also give at least one more proof of their background, such as a work email, a diploma or a portfolio.

In regulated fields such as medicine, law and finance we go further: we check the professional license against the official register, and our team holds a short video interview before approving anyone. Business mentors show their company or their role in it.

A person on our team reviews every step and writes down why. Your ID photos never reach Wisecall, and a mentor’s license number and documents are never public. Profiles show only badges for the checks passed, with the date.

After approval we keep checking: a new mentor’s first answers are reviewed before you see them, buyers can report a mentor, low ratings are looked at again, and we can suspend a profile at once. We remove people who mislead others.
Mentors set their own price and answer in their own time. Wisecall keeps a small platform fee to run the service and pays the rest out to the mentor.
Answers are personal experience and opinion, not professional medical, legal, or financial advice. See our Terms for details.
Wisecall is made for Georgia first, in Georgian and English. Questions, answers, and the whole site work in both languages.
Questions or ideas? We would love to hear them. Use the contact page.

hv.sub: Nobody appears in Browse experts just by signing up. Every mentor goes through these checks first, and a person on our team approves each one.
hv.1.title: A real person
hv.1.body: A government ID and a live selfie, checked by our identity partner. The name on the ID has to match their profile and payout account.
hv.2.title: Real experience
hv.2.body: A proof link, a sample answer, and at least one more proof of background: a work email, a diploma or a portfolio. Our team reads all of it.
hv.3.title: Licensed where it matters
hv.3.body: Doctors, lawyers and financial advisers also give us their license or registration, and we check it against the official register.
hv.4.title: Met on video
hv.4.body: In regulated fields, our team also holds a short video interview before approving anyone.
hv.5.title: Watched after approval
hv.5.body: A new mentor's first answers are checked before you see them. Reports and low ratings are reviewed, and we can suspend a profile at once.

mock.aria: An example of a question and an answer on Wisecall
mock.q.label: A question
mock.q.text: I'm a marketing manager who wants to move into product design. Should I start with a course, or build projects first?
mock.a.label: An answer
mock.a.text: Build first. Pick one real problem, design a small fix for it, and write down your thinking. Two solid case studies beat any certificate. A course helps once you know which gaps you have.

ex.title: What an answer looks like
ex.sub: Three examples written by the Wisecall team to show the kind of question people ask and the kind of answer they get. They are not real customers or real mentors.
ex.label: Example
ex.1.q: I'm self-taught and want my first developer job. Should I learn Python or JavaScript first?
ex.1.a: Pick the one that matches the jobs you can actually apply to. Look at ten local job posts, count which language shows up most, and start there. Depth in one language beats a little of both.
ex.2.q: I'm launching a small product and have no competitors to compare prices with. How do I price it?
ex.2.a: Start from the value, not the cost. Ask five likely customers what they pay today to solve the problem, and price at a fraction of that. You can raise a price later, but it is hard to lower one.
ex.3.q: My class of 25 teenagers talks over me. How do I get their attention without shouting?
ex.3.a: Choose one signal and use it every time: a raised hand, a countdown, or silence at the front. Practise it on the first day, thank the first students who follow it, and wait. Consistency matters more than volume.
trust.title: Why trust Wisecall

trust.2.body: You pay in lari on your bank's own secure page. Wisecall never sees or stores your card number.
trust.3.title: Full refund if nobody answers
trust.3.body: If your mentor doesn't answer within {answerDays} days, you get all your money back automatically. You don't have to ask.
trust.4.title: Honest, public reviews
trust.4.body: Only people who paid for and received an answer can leave a review. Mentors can't edit or hide them.

price.2.title: Nothing to cancel
price.2.body: There is no membership and no monthly charge. Ask one question, or many, whenever you need to.

price.tips.title: What makes a good question
price.tip1: Give context: who you are, where you are now and what you want.
price.tip2: Say what you already tried, so the mentor doesn't repeat it.
price.tip3: Ask one clear thing. One question, one answer.
price.tip4: Say how you will use the answer, for example a decision you have to make by a certain date.

mentors.how.title: How to become a mentor
mentors.how.1.title: Create an account and apply
mentors.how.1.body: Sign up, then tell us your field, your price and how we can check your experience.
mentors.how.2.title: Get verified
mentors.how.2.body: Confirm your ID and show proof of your experience. In regulated fields we also check your license. A person on our team reviews each step.
mentors.how.3.title: Start answering
mentors.how.3.body: Once you are approved and have added your bank account, you appear in Browse experts. Answer from your dashboard and get paid by bank transfer.
faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.1.a: You choose a mentor, ask one question and pay the price on their profile. The mentor answers in your dashboard and by email, and you can rate the answer.
faq.2.a: Each mentor sets their own price per question, between {priceMin} and {priceMax} ₾. You pay once per question. There are no subscriptions or hidden fees.
faq.3.q: What if the mentor doesn't answer?
faq.3.a: Mentors have {answerDays} days to answer. If they don't, your payment is refunded in full automatically. You don't need to contact us.
faq.4.a: Yes. You pay on your Georgian bank's secure page, in lari. Wisecall never sees or stores your card number.
faq.5.a: Every mentor is reviewed by a person on our team: an ID and selfie check, proof of experience and, in regulated fields like medicine and law, a professional license and a video interview. See "How we verify mentors" above.
faq.6.q: Can I get a refund if I don't like the answer?
faq.6.a: After an answer is delivered, payments are generally not refundable. We refund in full if the answer is spam, empty, off-topic or breaks our terms; contact us within 7 days. Disliking an answer is not a reason for a refund, but you can leave an honest review.
faq.7.q: How long until I get my answer?
faq.7.a: Your mentor has up to {answerDays} days. You get an email as soon as they answer, and the answer appears in your dashboard.
faq.8.q: Is this professional medical, legal or financial advice?
faq.8.a: No. Answers are personal experience and opinion, not professional advice, and they don't replace a doctor, a lawyer or a financial adviser. In an emergency, call the emergency services.
faq.9.q: How do I become a mentor and get paid?
faq.9.a: Sign up and apply in Settings. After we verify you and you add your bank account (IBAN), you appear in Browse experts. Each answer's earnings become payable {holdDays} days later and are sent by bank transfer.
faq.10.a: The whole site works in English and Georgian, and you can switch at any time. Ask in the language you are most comfortable with.
